say.en: Walk on wet sand and your footprints stay behind. Every click, like and search leaves a footprint too, and the Internet rarely washes it away. In this lesson: Define digital footprint.
Tell active from passive footprints.
Manage your own footprint.

body.en: A digital footprint is the record of data we leave while using digital devices and the Internet. An *active* footprint is data we submit on purpose, such as emails, posts and online forms. A passive footprint is data collected without our direct action, such as browsing history, IP address and cookies.
body.kn: ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗುರುತು ಎಂದರೆ ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಬಳಸುವಾಗ ಬಿಡುವ ದತ್ತಾಂಶದ ದಾಖಲೆ. ನಾವು ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಕೊಡುವುದು ಸಕ್ರಿಯ (ಇಮೇಲ್, ಪೋಸ್ಟ್). ನಮಗೆ ಅರಿವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸಂಗ್ರಹವಾಗುವುದು ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯ (ಬ್ರೌಸಿಂಗ್ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಐಪಿ ವಿಳಾಸ, ಕುಕೀಗಳು).

title.en: How big is your digital footprint?

narration.en: Every post you make is an active footprint; every search, click and cookie is a passive one. They add up year after year and are hard to delete. Privacy settings limit who can see the active part. Post 5 times a day for 3 years in public. How many traces? Which setting cuts what strangers see, and which part does it not touch?
narration.kn: ನೀವು ಮಾಡುವ ಪ್ರತಿ ಪೋಸ್ಟ್ ಸಕ್ರಿಯ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗುರುತು; ಪ್ರತಿ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ, ಕ್ಲಿಕ್, ಕುಕೀ ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯ. ವರ್ಷದಿಂದ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ, ಅಳಿಸುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟ. ಗೌಪ್ಯತಾ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್‌ಗಳು ಸಕ್ರಿಯ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಯಾರು ನೋಡಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಮಿತಿಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. 3 ವರ್ಷ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ 5 ಪೋಸ್ಟ್ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ. ಎಷ್ಟು ಕುರುಹು? ಯಾವ ಸೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಅಪರಿಚಿತರು ನೋಡುವುದನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಯಾವ ಭಾಗ ಬದಲಾಗದು?

title.en: On the board: Active and passive digital footprints

say.en: Every time we go online we leave a trail of data. This trail is our digital footprint.
An active footprint is data we share on purpose: posts, e-mails, comments and online forms.
A passive footprint is collected without our direct action: cookies, browsing history, location and IP address.
Both are stored on servers and copied, so they are very hard to erase. Think before you post.

text.en: Stored on servers: hard to erase

problem.en: Classify each as an active or passive footprint: (a) a WhatsApp status, (b) cookies saved by a shopping site, (c) an online exam form, (d) the location history of your phone.

steps.en: (a) A status is posted by you on purpose → active.
(b) Cookies are saved in the background → passive.
(c) You fill in the form yourself → active.
(d) Location history is logged automatically → passive.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Classify each as an active or passive footprint: (a) a WhatsApp status, (b) cookies saved by a shopping site, (c) an online exam form, (d) the location history of your phone.

say.en: Let us work through this case together. Classify each as an active or passive footprint: a a WhatsApp status, b cookies saved by a shopping site, c an online exam form, d the location history of your phone.
a A status is posted by you on purpose gives active.
b Cookies are saved in the background gives passive.
c You fill in the form yourself gives active.
d Location history is logged automatically gives passive.
So the answer is Active: a, c. Passive: b, d.

body.en: If you acted to share it, it is active. If it was picked up as you passed by, it is passive.
